entries.summary: Spring Boot 3 runs on Jakarta EE 9+; javax.servlet types must migrate to jakarta.servlet.
proposedChecks: Replace javax.servlet imports with jakarta.servlet equivalents
Remove explicit javax.servlet-api dependency if present

entries.summary: javax.annotation.PostConstruct moved to jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct in Boot 3.
Spring Boot 3 defaults to PathPatternParser; explicit ant_path_matcher remains supported but warrants review after upgrade.
proposedChecks: Review whether ant_path_matcher is still required after upgrade

entries.summary: Upgrading spring-boot-starter-parent from 2.7.x to 3.2.x requires Java 17+ and Jakarta migration across the codebase.
proposedChecks: Set java.version to 17 or higher in pom.xml
Run OpenRewrite spring boot 3 migration recipe in dry-run mode
